description: The bar chart compares the distribution of three categories—Context, Generated Response, and Other—across two conditions: "Ours" and "Standard." The horizontal axis represents the two conditions, while the vertical axis shows the percentage contribution of each category, with values labeled directly on the bars. For the "Ours" condition, the blue "Context" segment accounts for 60.6%, the orange "Generated Response" segment for 7.7%, and the green "Other" segment for 7.7%. In the "Standard" condition, the "Context" segment is 23.6%, the "Generated Response" segment is 51.1%, and the "Other" segment is 25.3%. The legend at the bottom identifies the color coding for each category. The bars are arranged horizontally, with the "Ours" bar positioned above the "Standard" bar, and the segments within each bar are stacked to show the proportional contribution of each category to the total. The percentages sum to 100% for each condition, indicating a complete breakdown of the components.
